sections.heading: Layoffs follow-up · GM search
bullets: Layoffs follow-up: The Athletic (via Camden Chat) puts the business-side cuts at **24+ people**, including the performers behind **the Oriole Bird and Mr. Splash**. Also cut: the team photographer and people in ticket sales, graphic design and food & beverage. No official reason has been given.

GM search: Interviews are ramping up this week, though **no names yet**. The pool includes up-and-coming player-development leaders from other organizations and at least one candidate with both MLB playing and executive experience. The O's could hire more than one executive. The lockout looms Dec 1.

sections.heading: Business-side layoffs · GM search still open
bullets: Business-side layoffs (Tue): The Banner and the Sun report cuts in business operations, content production and in-game presentation; the Sun's source says "around a dozen, if not more." The cuts were reportedly not tied to the expected December lockout. Business president Catie Griggs's memo said no further staff changes are expected.
GM search: There are **no candidate names and no hire**. Elias's search is still open, and earlier targets Kantrovitz and Barfield declined.
